h2. Description

*Escape must close an open menu without changing anything — including the Technician filter's list when the cursor is in its "Search technician" box.* On staging, once you click into that box, Escape does nothing: the list stays open, even after pressing Escape again.

For example,
* the Technician list is opened and closed with Escape — it closes, as expected
* the list is opened again and the user clicks into *Search technician* (or types a name) — Escape no longer closes it; only a click outside does

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin at *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and click *Board View*.
# Click the *Technician* filter, then press Escape.
#* The list closes.
# Click the *Technician* filter again and click inside the *Search technician* box at the top of the list.
# Press Escape, then press Escape again.
#* The list is still open both times.
# Type a technician's first name (for example *Ralph*) in *Search technician* and press Escape.
#* The list is still open and the typed name stays.
# Click *Tech View* in the display switcher and repeat steps 3 to 6.
#* The same happens in Tech View.

*Actual Result:*
* With the cursor in *Search technician*, Escape does not close the Technician list, in Board View and in Tech View.

*Expected Result:*
* Escape closes the Technician list without changing anything, wherever the cursor is in it. The PRD says: *"Escape closes an open menu, dialog or tooltip without changing anything."*
